candidates.title: Hyderabad: OHE failure after power lines snap over Intercity Express near Moulali
candidates.excerpt: An overhead electrical equipment failure was reported near Moulali on Sunday night after power lines reportedly snapped over a moving Intercity Express. The train was stopped as a precaution, while railway officials launched restoration measures. No casualties or injuries were reported.

candidates.title: Heavy rain lashes Hyderabad, parts of Telangana
candidates.excerpt: Heavy rains lashed Telangana under renewed active monsoon conditions, with Siddipet recording the State’s highest rainfall. Kondapak received 145.3 mm, while several Hyderabad areas, including Secunderabad, Bowenpally and Alwal, witnessed heavy rain and waterlogging in low-lying areas.

candidates.title: Why the BRICS summit was a major diplomatic win for India
candidates.excerpt: The 18th BRICS Summit in New Delhi is being seen as a significant diplomatic achievement for India. From pushing reforms in global governance to strengthening trade cooperation and facilitating dialogue among rival nations, the summit highlighted India’s growing role as a bridge between competing global powers. Here’s a look at the key outcomes and why the New Delhi Declaration matters.

candidates.title: Police to grill ex-soldier in Secunderabad armoury heist case
candidates.excerpt: A court in Telangana's Secunderabad has sent former army NCO Upputholla Mallesh to police custody for seven days in connection with the theft of firearms and ammunition from the 20 Battalion, Madras Regiment's armoury in Bolarum.

candidates.title: Hyderabad: Eight booked under POCSO over alleged sexual assault of 16-year-old girl
candidates.excerpt: Alwal police registered a POCSO case against eight persons following a complaint alleging the sexual assault of a 16-year-old girl. Police said the girl was allegedly assaulted at multiple locations after being intoxicated, and efforts are underway to identify all those involved.
